about: The LinkedIn Beats vocabulary bank: the lady's 57 recordings by expression family, the expressions the band can sing, the contrast couplet ("It's not X. It's Y."), the song roles that use them and the casting rules that rotate them. LEXICON.md is the readable version. Lengths are seconds of voice: the lady from lady-phrases.json; Synthia from Flite slt (pitch 1.04) rendered offline; Strategy from his existing Kokoro masters where a take exists, otherwise estimated as Flite x the median Kokoro/Flite ratio of his 13 takes. Re-measure Strategy after rendering.
principle: Synergy sings the post. The band answers in the lexicon.

lady.engine: ElevenLabs recordings, public/phrases/NN.wav, word times in lady-phrases.json
lady.treatment: as today: retuned per cut to the track scale
lady.rule: Only words one recording already says, cut on her measured boundaries. No splices across recordings.

strategy.treatment: pixel: a bit-crushed, sample-held take (not a vocoder), tuned to the pentatonic; Whisper must still hear every word
strategy.rule: Authority lines: the confession (X), the jargon of power, hustle, sign-offs.

synthia.treatment: clean and dry, tuned to the pentatonic; the fluent synth player, so her lines may wander most
synthia.rule: Trainer lines: the reframe (Y), AI tells, wellness, engagement calls.

synergy.engine: eSpeak NG through the vocoder (song.js, vocoder.js)
synergy.treatment: as today, but less of it
synergy.rule: Sings the post and hosts. No lexicon lines except the sign-off.

single.what: One word, said like a verdict.

refrain.what: A short phrase (2 to 9 syllables) that loops a bar or two and wanders: each repeat takes a new path through the pentatonic, the last one resolves home.
refrain.who: the lady (retuned per vowel, as the ladder is), Synthia, Strategy
refrain.where: Drop A from its second bar, Drop B, the outro; in Offsite a round, like her ladder

couplet.what: It's not X. It's Y. As the drop: "It's not X." over the build's first two bars (where Synergy answers today), then the tag "It's a-", the silence, and Y as the impact. As the anthem: two to four couplets, a bar each, then the template.
couplet.who: Strategy sings X; Synthia, or the lady when she owns the word, sings Y
couplet.where: the build, the tag and the impact; Drop B and the outro, in place of the hook's later repeats

call.what: Opens an exchange; another voice answers.
call.where: the end of a verse line, the gap before Drop B

answer.what: Closes an exchange in one to four words, deadpan.
answer.where: right after its call, in the same bar

stab.what: One word, said like a verdict.
stab.where: today's bend, lift and punct gaps; an offbeat in the verse

signoff.what: The last line before the tape stop, in place of Synergy's fixed "Let's circle back".
signoff.who: the line's own voice; Synergy only for "Let's circle back" in Circle Back
signoff.where: where "Let's circle back" is today (Circle Back bar 28)

form.principle: Synergy sings the post and hosts; the band (Strategy, Synthia, the lady) sings the lexicon.
form.hook: the post's own words (lyrics.js), sung by Synergy at most three times: the verse, Drop A, once in Drop B; the band takes the other repeats
form.build: her ladder, cast by topic and rotation; on a couplet drop, Strategy's "It's not X." over the first two bars (where Synergy answers today), and on one couplet drop in three her ladder is "It's not"
form.drop: one of her tag cuts with its impact, or a drop-ready couplet: Synthia's tag ("It's a quick-"), the silence, the impact ("SYNC.")
form.dropA: stabs in today's bend gap; the refrain enters from the second bar
form.sinkIn: as today (her sink cut), cast by topic
form.dropB: the refrain, or the anthem: two to four couplets on the post's topic, then the template (22) or her 09
form.outro: the sign-off, then her stop line under the tape stop

casting.keys: house and evergreen entries: "tag:NN.wav" is her tag cut from that recording (with its impact), "NN.wav:DISPLAY" her ladder cut, "couplet:id" a couplet drop, anything else a bank id
fallback: quote: the post says the line, its X or its Y
topic: the line's concepts meet the post's (casting.js readPost)
house: the track's own rotation for the slot, by hash and freshness
evergreen: lines that fit any post, by hash and freshness
today's line: "Let's build." and "Let's circle- BACK.", last

freshness.input: castSong(post, {recent}) with recent = lexicon keys used per slot, oldest first; casting stays pure

casting.hash: FNV-1a of the post text, salted per slot (drop 11, ladder 12, refrain 14, sign-off 15) so the slots do not move together

caps.perSong: one drop, one ladder, one refrain, up to three anthem couplets, one sign-off; no recording twice, no lexicon id twice, no content word twice across the hook and the band

corpus.about: checks over the sample and the 60 fixtures, without history (hash only); the prototype meets each

casting.sensitive: a post that matches casting.js SENSITIVE (family, health, grief), unless it is the work-family joke, gets no couplet in its drop and only meetings and metrics couplets in its anthem

coupletDrop.also: when the post argues "not X, it's Y" (concept notabout) or a couplet scores 2 or more on topic
coupletDrop.itsNotLadder: one couplet drop in three: her ladder is "It's not" (09 or 22)

retired.ladder: 50.wav "Let's build." loses its baseline; it plays when the post is about building
retired.tag: 06.wav "Let's circle- BACK." plays on one Circle Back song in four (hash), and nowhere else unless the post says it
retired.signoff: "Let's circle back" stays Circle Back's sign-off; the other tracks rotate
retired.hook: the post's hook stays the post's words; Synergy sings it at most three times, the band takes the other repeats
